name: @castellan/rust
//: Façade so turbo can see the Rust workspace as ONE node in the repo-wide task graph. It carries no dependencies of its own — Cargo owns those. Every script `cd ..` first because the Cargo workspace root is the repository root (crates/ has no Cargo.toml), and cargo-deny in particular reads Cargo.toml/deny.toml from the directory it runs in. `--workspace` is load-bearing: it covers the two Tauri app crates under apps/*/src-tauri as well as everything under crates/. Copied from geoquery's @geoquery/rust, with one addition: `codegen`, the task that derives packages/protocol/src/generated from castellan-protocol.

scripts.lint: cd .. && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo deny --workspace check bans licenses sources
